question: How does Ask Fern handle access to documentation based on user permissions?
ground_truth: Ask Fern automatically respects the role-based access control (RBAC) settings configured in your documentation. When users query Ask Fern, they only receive answers from documentation they have permission to access based on their assigned roles. This access control works at all levels, from entire sections down to individual pages and conditional content within pages.
